description: Gradle tasks, Java runtime setup, and Minecraft/Eaglercraft jar & source identification.
workspaceTrust: Running Gradle tasks and installing a JDK requires a trusted workspace.
view.insights.name: JarBench Insights
view.gradleTasks.name: Gradle Tasks
taskdef.rootPath: The path to the folder containing the Gradle project, defaults to the workspace folder.
config.javaHome: Path to the JDK JarBench should use for Gradle builds and jar inspection. Leave empty to auto-detect (`JAVA_HOME`, `PATH`, or an install JarBench manages).
config.autoDetectJava: Automatically look for a usable JDK and offer to install one when none is found.
config.gradleAutoDetect: Controls whether JarBench scans for Gradle build files and exposes their tasks as VS Code tasks.
config.jarFingerprintDb: Path to a JSON file of known jar SHA-256 fingerprints (see the extension's data/jar-fingerprints.json for the format). Leave empty to use the bundled (empty) default.
config.recommendJavaExtensionPack: Offer to install the Extension Pack for Java (diagnostics, completion, navigation, refactoring) the first time a .java file is opened.
